ambiguities.question: Does /gstack-plan-review Round 0 write per-item records (<id>.json) or only all.json? /gstack-build Step 2 check reads per-item records, so a whole-file run alone would give spec_review_missing.
For a goal item <id>/<n>, is check invoked without --items against PLAN.md's all.json, or with --items <id>/<n>? SR-001.1 refuses an id the doc doesn't contain.
Is a whole-file all.json record on DESIGN.md (run with no --items) a valid record for check, given Dorian's approved scope of 'not the whole DESIGN.md'?
Are conflicts between two items in the same --items batch ever checked? The intro says 'items under build' are cross-checked pairwise, but SR-001.1 reviews 'each named item on its own'.
Is scope_sha256 over exactly the doc-derived scope, or over the full request text including the prompt wrapper? check can only recompute the doc-derived part.
Where is GSTACK_ANTHROPIC_ENV set for the executing principal (local versus Cowork proxy)? Without that, the credential requirement can't be shown to be satisfiable where the gate runs.
